1.w: Sexual immorality is actually heard [of] among you⁺, and sexual immorality such as [is] not even among the nations, so as for one to have the wife of the father.

2.w: And you⁺ are puffed up! And did you not rather mourn, so that the one having done this work might be removed out of your⁺ midst?

3.w: For I indeed, being absent in body but being present in spirit, have already judged the one having thus carried this out, as being present,

4.w: in the name our Lord Jesus, [in] your⁺ having been gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of the Lord Jesus,

5.w: to deliver up such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord.

6.w: Your⁺ boasting [is] not good. Do you⁺ not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?

7.w: Cleanse out the old leaven, so that you⁺ may be a new lump, as you⁺ are, unleavened. For also Christ our Passover was sacrificed,

8.w: so that we may keep the feast, not with old leaven, not with leaven of malice and wickedness, but with unleavened [bread] of sincerity and of truth.

9.w: I wrote to you⁺ in the letter not to associate with sexually immoral [people],

10.w: not altogether with the sexually immoral of this world, or with the coveters and swindlers, or idolaters—since then you⁺ would need to go out from the world.

11.w: But now I wrote to you⁺ not to associate with anyone being named a brother if he may be sexually immoral or a coveter, or an idolater or a reviler, or a drunkard or a swindler—with such a one not even to eat.

12.w: For what [is it] to me to judge those outside? Do you⁺ not judge those inside?

13.w: But God judges those outside. “Expel the wicked one from among yourselves.”
